title: Shard configuration
description: One running world (wiki/Architecture.md). Gameplay code reads these values and never branches on the mode name (CLAUDE.md Section 5: shard config, not code).

mode.description: Rebang resets on reset_schedule and awards medals; permaverse never resets.

seed.description: Galaxy seed. The whole shard's map derives from this.

fuel_start.description: Warp fuel a new character starts with.

fuel_per_minute.description: Real-time accrual rate, online or offline (computed lazily from timestamps).

jump_cost.description: Warp fuel consumed per gate jump.

npc_density.description: Multiplier on NPC spawns (read from M3 on).

paradise_count.description: Paradise worlds per shard (placed at M4).

medal_ranks.description: How many top experience ranks earn a medal at a rebang reset.

reset_schedule.description: Rebang only: when the shard resets. Format decided when resets are implemented (M6 hardening).
